conventions: Capacity is gross capacity (Bruttoleistung) in kW unless the field name says mw, gw, mwh or gwh.
Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), months YYYY-MM, all in German local dates as registered; time series from APIs are UTC.
Germany only, except auctions/players.json and the worldwide parts of auctions/company_facts.json.
Every file carries or inherits the as_of date of manifest.json; recent months are incomplete because units are registered weeks late (manifest.incomplete_after gives the date per technology).
Units of natural persons have no name, operator or coordinates; small units appear only in totals (summary.parquet).
Operator and bidder names only for legal entities; operator names only for units of 1 MW or more.
Company groups come from name rules, office addresses and hand-checked assignments; 'Not attributed' means the owner is unknown.

starter_queries.q: Which wind and solar units of 1 MW or more went online in March 2026, and where?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT technology, name, capacity_kw/1000 AS mw, state, district, municipality, lat, lon FROM '{data}units.parquet' WHERE technology IN ('wind_onshore','solar') AND commissioning_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND capacity_kw >= 1000 ORDER BY capacity_kw DESC

starter_queries.q: How do the cost sources compare for onshore wind investment (€/kW)?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT r.label, r.year, r.eur_value, r.eur_low, r.eur_high, r.method FROM (SELECT unnest(wind_onshore.capex_compare) AS r FROM read_json_auto('{data}costs/costs.json'))

starter_queries.q: How much capacity per technology went online in 2025 (all sizes)?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT technology, round(sum(capacity_kw)/1e6, 2) AS gw, sum(unit_count) AS units FROM '{data}summary.parquet' WHERE commissioning_month LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY technology ORDER BY gw DESC

starter_queries.q: Which districts have the most onshore wind in operation?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT district, state, round(sum(capacity_kw)/1000) AS mw, count(*) AS turbines FROM '{data}units.parquet' WHERE technology = 'wind_onshore' AND status = 'operating' GROUP BY district, state ORDER BY mw DESC LIMIT 15

starter_queries.q: Which large batteries (≥ 10 MW) are planned, and where?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT name, capacity_kw/1000 AS mw, storage_capacity_kwh/1000 AS mwh, state, district, planned_commissioning_date FROM '{data}units.parquet' WHERE technology = 'storage' AND status = 'planned' AND capacity_kw >= 10000 ORDER BY capacity_kw DESC

starter_queries.q: Who owns the most onshore wind capacity (companies, units ≥ 1 MW)?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT operator_name, round(sum(capacity_kw)/1000) AS mw, count(*) AS turbines FROM '{data}units.parquet' WHERE technology = 'wind_onshore' AND status = 'operating' AND operator_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY operator_name ORDER BY mw DESC LIMIT 20

starter_queries.q: What were the average award prices of the onshore wind rounds?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT r.bid_date, r.avg_ct, r.ceiling_ct, r.awarded_kw/1000 AS awarded_mw FROM (SELECT unnest(rounds) AS r FROM read_json_auto('{data}auctions/onshore.json')) ORDER BY r.bid_date

starter_queries.q: Which company groups won the most onshore wind capacity since 2019?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT "group", round(sum(kw)/1000) AS mw, count(*) AS awards FROM (SELECT unnest(awards, recursive := true) FROM read_json_auto('{data}auctions/awards.json')) WHERE "group" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "group" ORDER BY mw DESC LIMIT 15

starter_queries.q: Which solar awards since 2023 have a battery on site?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT round, bidder, "group", kw/1000 AS mw, state, district FROM (SELECT unnest(awards, recursive := true) FROM read_json_auto('{data}auctions/solar_awards.json')) WHERE co_located ORDER BY kw DESC LIMIT 20

starter_queries.q: Which wind projects won an award but are not running yet, by state?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT state, round(sum(kw - coalesce(kw_operating, 0))/1000) AS unbuilt_mw FROM (SELECT unnest(awards, recursive := true) FROM read_json_auto('{data}auctions/awards.json')) GROUP BY state ORDER BY unbuilt_mw DESC

starter_queries.q: How many turbines are older than 20 years, by state?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT state, count(*) AS turbines, round(sum(capacity_kw)/1000) AS mw FROM '{data}units.parquet' WHERE technology = 'wind_onshore' AND status = 'operating' AND commissioning_date < make_date(year(current_date) - 20, 1, 1) GROUP BY state ORDER BY mw DESC

starter_queries.q: Where do the TSOs curtail renewables most (last 12 months)?
starter_queries.sql: SELECT s.asset, round(s.mwh/1000) AS gwh, s.tso FROM (SELECT unnest(last_12m.renewable_substations) AS s FROM read_json_auto('{data}grid/redispatch.json')) ORDER BY s.mwh DESC

starter_queries.q: How much did Germany import and export per neighbour over the last 12 months?
starter_queries.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT json(last_12m) AS m FROM read_json_auto('{data}grid/flows.json')) SELECT k AS neighbour, (m->k->>'import_gwh')::DOUBLE AS import_gwh, (m->k->>'export_gwh')::DOUBLE AS export_gwh FROM f, unnest(json_keys(m)) AS t(k) ORDER BY import_gwh DESC
